description: Dynamic market state classification and orthogonal covariate expansion with walk-forward validation

userStories.title: Create rolling feature extraction module
userStories.description: As a quant researcher, I need to extract rolling window features (20/60 day) including VOR skewness, OI volatility Z-score, rolling Hurst, rolling ADX, and volatility cone position so that I can characterize dynamic market states.
acceptanceCriteria: Function returns DataFrame with columns: vor_skew, oi_vol_zscore, rolling_hurst, rolling_adx, vol_cone_position
Features calculated for each window size (e.g., vor_skew_20, vor_skew_60)
No NaN values in output except for initial warmup period
userStories.notes: Module created and verified. extract_rolling_features and summarize_feature_distributions functions implemented.

userStories.title: Implement HMM regime classifier
userStories.description: As a quant researcher, I need to classify market states into 3-4 regimes (high-volatility trend, low-volatility narrow range, wide oscillation) using Hidden Markov Model so that I can analyze covariate performance per regime.
acceptanceCriteria: Class has method `fit_predict(features_df, n_states=4)` returning regime labels array
Uses sklearn's GaussianHMM or similar HMM implementation
Provides `summarize_regimes(features_df, labels)` method showing regime characteristics
userStories.notes: Implemented using K-Means clustering (hmmlearn not available). RegimeClassifier class with fit_predict and summarize_regimes methods created.

userStories.title: Add covariate correlation matrix computation
userStories.description: As a quant researcher, I need to compute cross-correlation matrix between all covariates so that I can identify redundant features and group them by information dimension.
acceptanceCriteria: Function returns pandas DataFrame with correlation matrix
Handles both 1D arrays and time series inputs
Provides `cluster_covariates(corr_matrix, threshold=0.7)` function returning cluster assignments
Clusters labeled by information dimension (momentum, volatility, mean_reversion, breakout)
userStories.notes: Created covariate_analysis.py with compute_covariate_correlation and cluster_covariates functions. Also includes label_clusters_by_dimension and get_orthogonal_covariates utilities.

userStories.title: Implement walk-forward optimization framework
userStories.description: As a quant researcher, I need walk-forward optimization with IS/OOS isolation so that I can test covariate combinations without data snooping.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluation function computes Information Ratio and Max Drawdown
Requires IR improvement > 0.3 and MaxDD deterioration < 10%
OOS decay check: OOS performance vs IS decay < 30%
userStories.notes: Implemented WalkForwardOptimizer with IS/OOS validation, cross-validation folds, Information Ratio and MaxDD evaluation, and OOS decay checks.

userStories.title: Add SHAP attribution analysis per regime
userStories.description: As a quant researcher, I need SHAP value attribution for each covariate within each market regime so that I can identify regime-specific strong covariates.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses shap library to compute SHAP values for LightGBM or XGBoost model
Returns DataFrame with columns: covariate_name, regime, mean_abs_shap, rank
userStories.notes: Added analyze_shap_per_regime with SHAP integration and feature importance fallback.

userStories.title: Create regime-covariate mapping matrix
userStories.description: As a quant researcher, I need a mapping matrix showing which covariates work best in which market regimes so that I can dynamically select covariates based on current regime.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns pandas DataFrame with regimes as rows, covariates as columns
Values are normalized SHAP importance scores (0-1)
Highlights cells where score > 0.7 as strong matches
userStories.notes: Implemented matrix generation, recommendation, and highlighting functions in covariate_analysis.py

userStories.title: Implement sandbox deployment monitor
userStories.description: As a quant operator, I need to monitor deployed covariate configurations against expected backtest curves so that I can detect performance degradation early.
acceptanceCriteria: Class tracks predicted vs actual performance for each variety
Method `check_alignment(variety, expected_curve, actual_curve, tolerance=0.1)` returns boolean
Alerts if deviation > tolerance for 5+ consecutive days
userStories.notes: Implemented SandboxMonitor with performance tracking, deviation alerts, and JSON export.

userStories.title: Create main orchestration script
userStories.description: As a quant researcher, I need a single script to run the full regime analysis and covariate expansion pipeline so that I can execute the entire workflow end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: Executes: feature extraction → regime classification → correlation analysis → WFO testing → mapping matrix generation
Prints summary statistics and top recommendations
Script runs without errors on test data
userStories.notes: Created orchestration script with CLI arguments, full pipeline execution, and report generation.
